idea-plugin.name: AI Commit Message
idea-plugin.description:
Generates a Conventional Commit message from the changes included in the Commit tool window.

The message is written back into the commit message field for review. Use Settings | Tools | AI Commit Message to configure any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Nothing is committed automatically.

Highlights:

  • Reads the changes actually included in the Commit tool window, not git diff --cached
  • Supports partial changelist commits (per-block selections)
  • Falls back to the Responses API when chat/completions is unavailable
  • API key is stored in the IDE PasswordSafe; never written to config files or logs
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial release: generate Conventional Commit messages from included changes, with dual-protocol support (chat/completions with automatic Responses API fallback).
